metadata.description: Internal Copilot plugins for everyday engineering workflows.

plugins.name: Release Captain
plugins.description: Draft release notes, verify the branch is clean, and summarize remaining risk before you ship.
plugins.author: Developer Experience

plugins.name: Repo Explorer
plugins.description: Map an unfamiliar service: entry points, key modules, data flow, and where to make a change.
plugins.author: Platform Engineering

plugins.name: Review Companion
plugins.description: Review a pull request for logic errors, missing tests, and breaking changes before a human does.
plugins.author: Developer Experience

plugins.name: Incident Notebook
plugins.description: Turn an incident channel and logs into a timeline, root cause analysis, and follow-up actions.
plugins.author: SRE Guild

plugins.name: Test Architect
plugins.description: Find untested paths in a change set and scaffold cases that match the project's testing conventions.
plugins.author: Quality Engineering

plugins.name: Migration Pilot
plugins.description: Plan and stage a dependency or framework upgrade with a reversible, reviewable change sequence.
plugins.author: Platform Engineering
